_about: Recorded from server/cca-presence.py (Python 3.14.0) by a scratch script that is not part of the repository: ws_frames called in-process; the handshakes and pump scenarios run the real srv.Handler on one end of a socketpair, with a fake server object for the IP bucket, the tickets and the relay (WS_IDLE 0.6 s, WS_STALL 0.4 s, 80 ms after each step). Bodies longer than 256 bytes are {len, sha256}.
